content: The question of toll charges deserves thoughtful discussion. While tolls can play an important role in funding road construction, maintenance, and infrastructure development, it is equally important to consider their impact on ordinary citizens, particularly those with modest incomes. The goal should be to strike a fair balance between sustainable infrastructure financing and affordability, with transparent policies and appropriate exemptions where necessary. Good public policy should ensure that infrastructure development and the interests of citizens go hand in hand. 🇮🇳
comment: One overlooked factor is how tolls affect frequent commuters and local businesses. Distance-based pricing, reliable service standards and periodic audits could make the system fairer without compromising infrastructure funding.
